takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **68%** of 234 plays (n=160); also Slot 32% (n=74).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **14.3 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (deeper) (n=234, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (68%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
